title: Falcon's Quest Board

location.name: Phandalin — Falcon's Hunting Lodge
location.description: The frontier town of Phandalin, now with a new fixture: Falcon the Hunter's lodge, where a quest board posts jobs from townsfolk too frightened to handle their own troubles. A white dragon has been seen circling Icespire Peak, and the whole region is on edge.

read_aloud: Phandalin is much as you remember it — muddy streets, log buildings, the ring of the smithy — but a new tension hangs in the air. Townsfolk glance nervously at the sky. At Falcon's Hunting Lodge, a broad quest board bristles with jobs, and Falcon himself, a rangy retired adventurer, looks you over. 'You've the look of folk who can handle trouble,' he says. 'Good — because there's a DRAGON on the peak, and half the countryside needs saving.' As if on cue, a vast white shape wheels across the distant sky above Icespire, and every head in the street turns to watch it pass.

encounters.description: The quest board and Falcon's briefing. This is the hub — the party picks which jobs to pursue. Each posting maps to a later act. Cryovain's flyover establishes the looming threat without a fight.

npcs.name: Falcon the Hunter
dialog_hooks: Runs the quest board; pays out rewards for completed jobs
Warns that a young white dragon, Cryovain, has driven monsters down out of the peak
Suggests starting with the nearer jobs (Dwarven Excavation, Umbrage Hill, Gnomengarde)
Knows Icespire Hold is the dragon's lair but says it's suicide to go there unprepared

npcs.name: Townmaster Harbin Wester
dialog_hooks: Cowardly townmaster; posts the higher-bounty jobs (Axeholm, Woodland Manse)
Will pay well to have the dragon problem simply 'go away'

loot.location: Falcon advances the party supplies for taking the contract

skill_checks.success: Read Falcon as genuine — he truly wants the region saved, not just profit.
skill_checks.failure: He seems like just another job-broker.

dm_notes: SANDBOX HUB. Present the quest board via action-prompt as numbered jobs; the party's pick sets the transition. Return here between quests (each quest act transitions back to ch1-act-I unless the party chains onward). Gate the finale: discourage assaulting Icespire Hold (ch5) until the party is ~level 5-6 and ideally has the Hammer of the Dragon (Dragon Barrow) or Dragonguard. SCALING note applies to all combat acts (6 PCs, +50%). 3+ interactables: the quest board, the lodge's trophy wall (lore), the townsfolk (rumors).
